claim_boundary.allowed: A bounded retrospective benchmark of next-hour BTCUSDT direction prediction under a frozen historical split and simulated cost assumptions.
not_allowed: generalization beyond the frozen BTCUSDT period
a claim of market inefficiency from one positive backtest

research_question: Using only information available by the close of hour t, does a random-forest signal improve held-out next-hour direction prediction over persistence and logistic regression, and does any predictive improvement survive prespecified simulated transaction costs across frozen volatility/trend regimes?

dataset.source_family: Binance Public Data / Binance Vision spot monthly klines
dataset.reason_for_end_month: Stop before 2025-01-01, when the official public-data repository states that spot timestamps change from milliseconds to microseconds.
dataset.raw_archive_policy: Download the 60 monthly ZIP archives and their official .CHECKSUM companions. Verify every archive before parsing and lock observed SHA-256 values in data_manifest.lock.json. Archived-file replacement is treated as a new dataset version, never silently accepted.
dataset.gap_policy: Audit hourly open_time continuity. Never forward-fill OHLCV. Drop any sample whose feature lookback, entry bar, or exit bar intersects a missing/duplicate/non-monotonic timestamp and report every excluded interval before modeling.
dataset.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate open_time rows are forbidden; conflicting duplicate open_time rows fail the data gate.

held_out_unlock_requires: selected candidate configuration committed from validation only

sample_definition.overlap: Signals are generated hourly; uncertainty therefore uses time-block resampling rather than IID resampling.

features.rolling_convention: Trailing windows end at bar t and never include t+1 or later.
features.normalization: Only logistic regression is standardized; scaler is fit on the training split only and applied unchanged to validation/test.
features.missing_feature_policy: Drop rows until all frozen lookbacks are defined; never impute from future observations.

baselines.historical_mean: Constant probability equal to the training-set positive-class rate.
baselines.persistence: Use close_log_return_1h as the ranking score; predicted class is 1 when close_log_return_1h > 0, else 0.

candidate.selection_metric: mean validation ROC-AUC across the five frozen seeds
candidate.tie_break: If mean validation ROC-AUC differs by <= 1e-6, prefer the shallower finite max_depth; then prefer the larger min_samples_leaf.
candidate.held_out_primary_score: Mean predicted probability across the five frozen seed models after configuration selection is frozen from validation only.

metrics.primary_comparison: candidate ensemble ROC-AUC minus logistic-regression ROC-AUC
metrics.predictive_success_rule: Only describe the candidate as adding held-out predictive value if delta ROC-AUC >= 0.01 and the 95% moving-block-bootstrap CI lower bound for delta ROC-AUC is > 0. Otherwise report no demonstrated improvement.

simulated_economic_diagnostic.position_rule: Long 1 unit when candidate ensemble probability >= 0.55; otherwise flat. Position decided after bar t close and entered at open t+1.
required_outputs: annualized Sharpe using sqrt(24*365) only as a descriptive scaling
simulated_economic_diagnostic.claim_boundary: This is a retrospective simulated diagnostic, not an executable trading strategy or estimate of realizable profit.

regimes.volatility: Compute trailing 168h realized volatility. Freeze the training 33rd and 67th percentiles, then apply those fixed thresholds to validation and held-out test as low/mid/high.
regimes.trend: Compute trailing 168h close log return. Label down_or_flat when <= 0 and up when > 0.
regimes.cross_cells: Report all six volatility x trend cells with sample counts; retain losing/small cells and never redefine thresholds from held-out outcomes.

placebo.name: 168h timing-shift placebo
placebo.method: Within each evaluated split, shift the complete feature matrix forward by exactly 168 hourly rows relative to the targets and drop non-overlap; retrain/evaluate the same frozen procedure without changing any hyperparameter budget.
placebo.expected_behavior: Any genuine short-horizon alignment should materially weaken. A placebo that performs similarly to the aligned model is evidence against the claimed signal.

integrity_rules: No held-out test inspection before the unlock requirements are satisfied.
No post-hoc feature additions, regime changes, probability-threshold changes, cost changes, seed selection, or metric substitution after held-out unlock.
No deletion of losing seeds or regimes.
Any implementation correction after held-out access must be documented with before/after commit SHAs and must not be chosen based on whether it improves the headline result.
A failed or null result completes the cohort if the protocol and evidence package are reproducible.
